instruction: Please help me configure VS Code to insert spaces instead of tabs when pressing the Tab key.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring tab insertion behavior in VS Code. Similar complexity to original task but modifies editor indentation settings. Uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify editor.insertSpaces is set to true.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches VS Code settings file from /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json (correct location for Ubuntu/Linux)
Metric check_json_settings correctly loads JSON, extracts expected key-value pairs, and performs strict equality comparison
Expected value {"editor.insertSpaces": true} is semantically correct for the instruction requirement
Complete coverage: instruction requires configuring tab-to-spaces insertion, evaluator checks the exact VS Code setting (editor.insertSpaces)
Data flow is correct: vm_file getter returns file path -> metric loads JSON -> compares setting values
Robust error handling: metric handles missing files, JSON parse errors, missing keys, and None values correctly
No postconfig needed: VS Code persists settings automatically to settings.json file
No edge case issues: evaluator will work correctly at runtime
